REGULAR MAZDOOR RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION 2025
NOTICE
No.- 64/R&A Dated: 24th August, 2026
Vide this Court’s Notice No. 39/R&A dated 03.07.2026, Sri Manish Kumar Singh (Roll No.
100161, Reg No. 261337, Selected Category-EWS) was granted extension of joining period till
29.07.2026 for joining to the post of Regular Mazdoor, but he has neither joined within the stipulated
time nor prayed for further extension of joining time.
Subsequently, it is hereby informed that on account of his non-joining within the stipulated
extended time period as well as no prayer for further extension of joining time, Hon’ble Court have been
pleased to cancel his selection/appointment to the post of Regular Mazdoor under Regular Mazdoor
Recruitment Examination 2025.
By order of the Court
Sd/- Rupesh Deo
Registrar General
